events.name: Montreal Canadiens at Tampa Bay Lightning

headlines.description: — J.J. Moser scored 12:48 into overtime to give the Tampa Bay Lightning a 3-2 victory over the Montreal Canadiens on Tuesday night, tying the first-round playoff series at 1-1.
headlines.shortLinkText: Moser scores in OT as Lightning beat Canadiens 3-2 in Game 2 and tie first-round series

events.name: Utah Mammoth at Vegas Golden Knights

headlines.description: — Logan Cooley scored off a rebound with six minutes left to give the Mammoth a 3-2 victory over the Vegas Golden Knights on Tuesday night, and they will head back to Utah with a split of the first two games in their first-round playoffs series.
headlines.shortLinkText: Logan Cooley scores late as the Mammoth beat the Golden Knights 3-2 to even playoffs series

events.name: Los Angeles Kings at Colorado Avalanche

headlines.description: — Nicolas Roy scored on a rebound 7:44 into overtime and Scott Wedgewood made 24 saves, including a penalty shot, as the Colorado Avalanche beat the Los Angeles Kings 2-1 on Tuesday night to take a 2-0 lead in their first-round playoff series.
headlines.shortLinkText: Nicolas Roy scores on rebound 7:44 into OT, Avs rally for 2-1 win over Kings to take 2-0 series lead
